submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed no candidate exposure with a significant farm-adjusted linear effect on yield_kg (all p>0.13); irrigation_mm was the strongest candidate (coef ~-0.19, p~0.14). The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data (outcome ~ irrigation_mm + farm indicators) gave estimate -0.079, SE 0.112, p=0.479, so the effect was not confirmed at alpha=0.05. No exposure has a confirmed direct effect.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['nitrogen_ppm','phosphorus_ppm','potassium_ppm','soil_ph','irrigation_mm','seed_density','mulch_depth_cm','biochar_g','fungicide_ml','shade_pct']
for e in exposures:
    m1 = smf.ols(f'yield_kg ~ {e}*C(farm)', data=df).fit()
    terms = [t for t in m1.params.index if ':' in t]
    ft = m1.f_test(' = '.join([f'{t}' for t in terms]) + ' = 0') if False else None
    # build restriction string
    restr = ', '.join(terms)
    ft = m1.f_test(restr)
    print(f"{e:18s} interaction p={ft.pvalue:.3g}")
